machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Custom Starting Script
G90
M83
;COPYTAG
M140 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set Bed Temperature
M141 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set IR1-Bed
M142 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set IR2-Wall
T0 ; Head 0
G92 E0
T1 ; Head 1
G92 E0
M190 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set Bed Temperature
M109 S{material_print_temperature,0} T0 ; Set T0 hozzle for purge
M104 S{material_standby_temperature,1} T1 ; Set T1 hozzle for idle
G27 S0 T0
G27 S1 T0
G27 S0 T1
G27 S1 T1 ; Park
T{initial_extruder_nr}
; OPT_DYN_PRE(5|{material_print_temperature,0}|{material_standby_temperature,0}|5|{material_print_temperature,1}|{material_standby_temperature,1})
; OPT_DYN_H(6|3|528|26|8.9|4|4|280|3)
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Custom Ending Script
M255 S0 ;Flash Fuse off
M104 S0 T0 ; Hozzle T0
M104 S0 T1 ; Hozzle T1
G91 ; Relative coordinates
G1 Z5  F600  ; From last Z position move the bed down
;G90; going back to absolute coordinates
M83 ; Ext Rel
G27 S0; Park
G27 S1; Park
G1 E30 F250 ; Purge
G1 E-5.00  F300 ; Retract
G12; Wipe
T0
M106 S0; Part fan/blower off
M107; Disable fan
T1
M106 S0; Part fan/blower off
M107; Disable fan
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

nozzle_disallowed_areas.label: Nozzle Disallowed Areas
nozzle_disallowed_areas.description: A list of polygons with areas the nozzle is not allowed to enter.

prime_tower_position_y.value: prime_tower_size + max(extruderValue(skirt_brim_extruder_nr, 'brim_width') * extruderValue(skirt_brim_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 if adhesion_type == 'brim' or (prime_tower_brim_enable and adhesion_type != 'raft') else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'raft_margin') if adhesion_type == 'raft' else (extruderValue(skirt_brim_extruder_nr, 'skirt_gap') if adhesion_type == 'skirt' else 0)), max(extruderValues('travel_avoid_distance'))) - max(extruderValues('support_offset')) - sum(extruderValues('skirt_brim_line_width')) * extruderValue(skirt_brim_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 - (resolveOrValue('draft_shield_dist') if resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') else 0) - max(map(abs, extruderValues('machine_nozzle_offset_y'))) + 2
